arxiv-1803-09371.description: Abstract . Stack Overflow (SO) has been a great source of natural language questions and their code solutions (i.e., question-code pairs), which are critical for many tasks including code retrieval and annotation. In most existing research, question-code pairs were collected heuristically and tend to have low quality.

arxiv-2007-09437.title: The spring bounces back: Introducing the Strain Elevation Tension Spring embedding algorithm for network representation
arxiv-2007-09437.creator: Jonathan Bourne
arxiv-2007-09437.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Jonathan Bourne. This paper introduces the Strain Elevation Tension Spring embedding (SETSe) algorithm, a graph embedding method that uses a physics model to create node and edge embeddings in undirected attribute networks. Using a low-dimensional representation, SETSe is able to differentiate between graphs that are designed to appear identical using standard network metrics such as number of nodes, number of edges and assortativity.

arxiv-2008-06314.title: A Note on the Finite Convergence of Alternating Projections Journal: Operations Research Letters
arxiv-2008-06314.creator: Hoa T. Bui, Ryan Loxton, Asghar Moeini
arxiv-2008-06314.description: Abstract We establish sufficient conditions for finite convergence of the alternating projections method for two non-intersecting and potentially nonconvex sets. Our results are based on a generalization of the concept of intrinsic transversality, which until now has been restricted to sets with nonempty intersection.

arxiv-2107-11891.title: Phase Spectrometry For High Precision mm-Wave DoA Estimation In 5G Systems
arxiv-2107-11891.creator: Farzam Hejazi, Nazanin Rahnavard
arxiv-2107-11891.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce a direction of arrival (DoA) estimation method based on a technique named phase spectrometry (PS) that is mainly suitable for mm-Wave and Tera-hertz applications as an alternative for DoA estimation using antenna arrays. PS is a conventional technique in optics to measure phase difference between two waves at different frequencies of the spectrum.

arxiv-2108-12747.title: Fragility of the nematic spin liquid induced by diagonal couplings in the square-lattice SU(3) model
arxiv-2108-12747.creator: Xiao-Tian Zhang 1, Wen-Jun Hu 2, Elbio Dagotto 2,3, Shoushu Gong 1
arxiv-2108-12747.description: Abstract We present a large-scale density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) study of the spin- 1 1 SU(3) bilinear-biquadratic model on the square lattice, which was suggested to host a nematic spin liquid state in recent DMRG calculations. We report that this spin liquid appears to strongly compete with a three-sublattice magnetic order.

arxiv-2110-07618.title: Function-space Inference with Sparse Implicit Processes
arxiv-2110-07618.creator: Simón Rodríguez Santana, Bryan Zaldivar, Daniel Hernández-Lobato
arxiv-2110-07618.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Simón Rodríguez Santana, Bryan Zaldivar, Daniel Hernández-Lobato. Implicit Processes (IPs) represent a flexible framework that can be used to describe a wide variety of models, from Bayesian neural networks, neural samplers and data generators to many others. IPs also allow for approximate inference in function-space. This change of formulation solves intrinsic degenerate problems of parameter-space approximate inference concerning the high number of parameters and their strong dependencies in large models.

arxiv-2111-14053.title: Towards Conditional Generation of Minimal Action Potential Pathways for Molecular Dynamics
arxiv-2111-14053.creator: John Kevin Cava, John Vant, Nicholas Ho, Ankita Shukla, Pavan Turaga, Ross Maciejewski, Abhishek Singharoy
arxiv-2111-14053.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by John Kevin Cava, John Vant, Nicholas Ho, Ankita Shukla, Pavan Turaga, Ross Maciejewski, Abhishek Singharoy. In this paper, we utilized generative models, and reformulate it for problems in molecular dynamics (MD) simulation, by introducing an MD potential energy component to our generative model. By incorporating potential energy as calculated from TorchMD into a conditional generative framework, we attempt to construct a low-potential energy route of transformation between the helix → \rightarrow coil structures of a protein.

arxiv-2210-02742.title: Towards the Multiple Constant Multiplication at Minimal Hardware Cost
arxiv-2210-02742.creator: Rémi Garcia, Anastasia Volkova
arxiv-2210-02742.description: Abstract Multiple Constant Multiplication (MCM) over integers is a frequent operation arising in embedded systems that require highly optimized hardware. An efficient way is to replace costly generic multiplication by bit-shifts and additions, i. e. a multiplierless circuit. In this work, we improve the state-of-the-art optimal approach for MCM, based on Integer Linear Programming (ILP).

arxiv-2402-12627.description: Abstract Recent artificial intelligence (AI) technologies show remarkable evolution in various academic fields and industries. arxiv-2405-17380.creator: Sureshkumar M and Prahlad Vaidyanathan
arxiv-2405-17380.description: Abstract . Given a separable, AF-algebra A A and an inductive limit action on A A of a finitely generated abelian group with finite Rokhlin dimension with commuting towers, we give a local description of the associated crossed product C*-algebra.

arxiv-2408-05795.title: A Meta-Engine Framework for Interleaved Task and Motion Planning using Topological Refinements
arxiv-2408-05795.creator: Elisa Tosello, Alessandro Valentini, Andrea Micheli
arxiv-2408-05795.description: Abstract Task And Motion Planning (TAMP) is the problem of finding a solution to an automated planning problem that includes discrete actions executable by low-level continuous motions. This field is gaining increasing interest within the robotics community, as it significantly enhances robot’s autonomy in real-world applications. Many solutions and formulations exist, but no clear standard representation has emerged.

arxiv-2408-09430.title: FASST: Fast LLM-based Simultaneous Speech Translation
arxiv-2408-09430.creator: Siqi Ouyang, Xi Xu, Chinmay Dandekar, Lei Li
arxiv-2408-09430.description: Abstract Simultaneous speech translation (SST) takes streaming speech input and generates text translation on the fly. Existing methods either have high latency due to recomputation of input representations, or fall behind of offline ST in translation quality. In this paper, we propose FASST, a fast large language model based method for streaming speech translation.

arxiv-2408-12377.title: From strange-quark tagging to fragmentation tagging with machine learning
arxiv-2408-12377.creator: Yevgeny Kats, and Edo Ofir
arxiv-2408-12377.description: Abstract We apply advanced machine learning techniques to two challenging jet classification problems at the LHC. The first is strange-quark tagging, in particular distinguishing strange-quark jets from down-quark jets. The second, which we term fragmentation tagging, involves identifying the fragmentation channel of a quark.

arxiv-2411-08273.title: On the inadequacy of nudging data assimilation algorithms for non-dissipative systems
arxiv-2411-08273.creator: Edriss S. Titi and Collin Victor
arxiv-2411-08273.description: Abstract . In this work, we study the applicability of the Azouani-Olson-Titi (AOT) nudging algorithm for continuous data assimilation to evolutionary dynamical systems that are not dissipative. Specifically, we apply the AOT algorithm to a partially dissipative variant of the Lorenz 1963 system, the Korteweg-de Vries equation (KdV) in 1D, and the 2D incompressible Euler equations.

arxiv-2506-06519.description: Abstract 6G networks have become increasingly complicated due to novel network architecture and newly emerging signal processing and transmission techniques, leading to significant burdens to 6G network management. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been considered a promising technique to equip 6G networks with AI-native intelligence.

arxiv-2508-01228.title: Inferring processes within dynamic forest models using hybrid modeling
arxiv-2508-01228.creator: Maximilian PichlerTheoretical EcologyUniversity of Regensburg93053 RegensburgGermany maximilian.pichler@ur.de, Yannek KäberBiometry and Environmental System AnalysisUniversity of Freiburg79098 FreiburgGermany yannek.kaeber@biom.uni-freiburg.de
arxiv-2508-01228.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maximilian PichlerTheoretical EcologyUniversity of Regensburg93053 RegensburgGermany maximilian.pichler@ur.de, Yannek KäberBiometry and Environmental System AnalysisUniversity of Freiburg79098 FreiburgGermany yannek.kaeber@biom.uni-freiburg.de. Modeling forest dynamics under novel climatic conditions requires a careful balance between process-based understanding and empirical flexibility. Dynamic Vegetation Models (DVM) represent ecological processes mechanistically, but their performance is prone to misspecified assumptions about functional forms. Inferring the structure of these processes and their functional forms correctly from data remains a major challenge because current approaches, such as plug-in estimators, have proven ineffective.

pmc-12796918.title: GⅡ型诺如病毒逆转录环介导等温扩增技术检测方法的建立
pmc-12796918.creator: 艺 刘, 晶 张, 超 赵, 娟 王
pmc-12796918.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). 目的建立基于逆转录环介导等温扩增技术（reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification，RT-LAMP）的GⅡ型诺如病毒快速检测方法。方法通过NCBI数据库和在线程序Primer Explorer V5筛选诺如病毒基因保守区并设计特异性引物，经实验条件优化（包括反应温度、MgSO4 浓度、dNTP浓度等）构建检测体系，评价该方法的检测灵敏性和特异性。利用优化后的方法检测临床粪便样本，并与商品化试剂盒进行比较。结果所建立的方法特异性良好，与腺病毒、人肠道通用型病毒及轮状病毒无交叉反应；灵敏性较好，检测限为51 copies/μL；检测时间为45 min；34份诺如病毒感染患者粪便样本与商品化试剂盒检测结果一致性较好，灵敏度为100%，特异度为83.33%，ROC曲线下面积为0.97 （95%CI：0.92～1.00），表明该方法具有较高的准确性和可靠性。结论本研究成功建立了基于RT-LAMP的GⅡ型诺如病毒检测方法，灵敏性、特异性及实际样本检测效果良好，适用于基层实验室和现场快速检测。 诺如病毒（norovirus, NoVs）感染是全球最常见的急性肠胃炎病因[1]，其流行病学特征突出表现为传染性极强、传播途径广泛[2]。作为重要的人兽共患病病原体和食源性传播病原体，诺如病毒不仅对人类健康构成严重威胁[3]，还对社会经济造成重大负担[4]。该病毒具有极强的环境稳定性，可通过污染的水源、食物、接触传播以及气溶胶等多种途径传播[5]，尤其在封闭或半封闭场所（如学校、养老院、医院等），极易引发聚集性疫情[6]。根据世界卫生组织（WHO）统计，全球每年因诺如病毒感染引发的急性胃肠炎病例超6亿人次，其中约20万例死亡病例发生于发展中国家[7]，这一数据充分凸显了诺如病毒感染已成为亟待重视的全球性公共卫生问题。 诺如病毒是一种无包膜的单股正链RNA病毒，病原学特征显示其直径约27～35 nm，基因组全长7.3～8.5 kb[8]。根据其基因特征，该病毒被分为10个基因群（genogroup, GI-GⅩ）[9]，其中GⅠ和GⅡ是人类感染的主要基因群[10]。流行病学研究表明，超过75%的人类急性胃肠炎病例由GⅡ基因群感染所致[11]，而GⅡ.4型更是占据了全球诺如病毒感染的70%以上[12]。人群对诺如病毒普遍易感[13]，感染后可引起呕吐、腹泻、发热等症状[14]，对儿童、老年人及免疫功能低下者的危害尤为严重[15]，尚无特效抗病毒药物和有效疫苗[16]，因此开发新型快速的现场检测技术，对于诺如病毒暴发流行的预警与防控具有重要意义。 传统的诺如病毒检测方法包括电镜检查[17]、免疫学技术[18-19]、分子生物学技术[20-21]和生物传感检测方法[22-23]等，我国食品诺如病毒检测的国家标准方法为实时荧光定量逆转录聚合酶链式反应（reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction, RT-PCR）[24-25]，然而这些方法普遍存在检测耗时久、成本高昂、对专业操作人员与精密仪器设备依赖性强等缺陷，难以适用于基层实验室的常规检测与现场快速筛查。 针对上述问题，本研究以GⅡ型诺如病毒为检测靶标，利用逆转录环介导等温扩增技术（reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification, RT-LAMP）所具备的快速扩增与等温反应特性[26-27]，构建一种新型诺如病毒检测体系。该体系可实现对GⅡ型诺如病毒的快速、精准且低成本检测，并可适用于实际样本的检测分析，为基层实验室及现场检测提供技术支持。 材料与方法 材料与试剂 GⅡ型诺如病毒（GⅡ.NoVs）、腺病毒（adenovirus, AD）、人肠道病毒（human enterovirus, HE）、轮状病毒（rotavirus, RV）、临床粪便样本34份（长春市儿童医院确诊的急性胃肠炎患儿，其诺如病毒GⅡ型感染状态已经由国家标准《GB 4789.42-2016》规定的RT-qPCR方法确认，其中阳性样本22份，阴性样本12份）；病毒RNA提取试剂盒、DEPC-H2O、dNTP（生工生物工程（上海）股份有限公司，中国）；WarmStart® RTx逆转录酶、Bst 2.0 WarmStart DNA聚合酶、WarmStart® Colorimetric LAMP 2X Master Mix (DNA&RNA)、硫酸镁（New England BioLabs公司，美国）；Eve Green荧光染料〔 翌圣生物科技（上海）股份有限公司，中国〕。本研究涉及的临床样本采集及使用已获得吉林大学公共卫生学院伦理委员会审批（审批号：2024-07-19），所有样本均由患者监护人签署知情同意书，并进行匿名处理，确保患者隐私。 实验仪器 －80 ℃冰箱（青岛海尔生物医疗股份有限公司，中国）；生物安全柜、实时荧光定量PCR（Thermo Fisher Scientific，美国）；磁力架、微型旋涡混合仪〔生工生物工程（上海）股份有限公司，中国〕；洁净工作台（苏州安泰空气技术有限公司，中国）；电泳仪、凝胶成像仪（上海天能科技公司，中国）；pH计（上海雷磁仪器有限公司，中国）。 实验方法 保守区确定与引物设计 利用美国国家生物技术信息中心（National Center for Biotechnology Information, pmc-13628197.title: Effect of evaluation prompt strategies on LLM-as-a-judge reliability in critical care
pmc-13628197.creator: Jia-Yu Yan, Wing-Sum Chan, Ching-Tang Chiu, Anne Chao, Po-Ni Hsiao, Shih-Chi Ku, Yu-Chang Yeh
pmc-13628197.description: BackgroundLarge language model (LLM)-as-a-judge systems offer scalable evaluation of artificial intelligence (AI)-generated clinical outputs, yet their susceptibility to prompt variability raises concerns regarding reproducibility and alignment with expert judgement. This study examined whether evaluation prompt strategies influence scoring patterns and concordance with clinical raters in critical care.
